summaries.body:
The mapping lists V6.7.1 as MODIFIED, MOVED FROM v4.0.3-2.9.1, and warns that predecessor text is dissimilar and git diverges. V2.9.1 required cryptographic keys used in verification to be stored securely against disclosure (TPM, HSM, or an OS service using that storage). The current clause is about certificates used to verify cryptographic authentication assertions, stored so they are protected from modification. Mapping and V2.9.1 are the attested origin of a cryptographic-verifier-storage control; the 5.0 text is a rewrite, not a copy.

janda26's 20 July 2020 glossary and acronym pass is the only git event on V2.9.1. Events labelled V5.2.5 (CWE, Grammarly, final text) are Authentication-chapter slot reuse, not this certificate rule.

Relative to V2.9.1, 5.0 switches from keys and disclosure (TPM/HSM) to certificates and modification. The supplied timeline has no commit that records that substitution. elar's 2021 space cleanup on V4.1.4 and other-slot events must not be read as rewriting this control.
